section_title: Basic pitched-roof envelopes for certain districts - paragraph (g), R1/R2-without-letter-suffix reference-plane allowance

source.capture_channel_note: THIS IS THE M4-T012 BINDING CAPTURE-COMPLETENESS PROOF. This raw-HTML finding contradicts the packet's stated premise that 'HTML extraction alone' cannot recover (g) from the raw bytes; the most likely explanation (not independently confirmed) is that the PRIOR sessions' HTML 'extraction' step used a readability/text-conversion tool that truncated or skipped content after the large embedded base64 image blob, rather than the raw HTTP response itself lacking the text. Per the task's BINDING instruction this snapshot nonetheless uses the PDF channel (never HTML alone) as its channel of record, and the corroborating raw-HTML byte inspection is recorded here as an additional, independently-obtained cross-check - not a substitute.

verbatim_excerpt:
(g) In R1 and R2 Districts without a letter suffix, for zoning lots that either:
(1) have a lot area of at least 9,500 square feet and lot width of at least 100 feet; or
(2) have a slope, as measured from the street wall line level to the rear wall line level, of at least five percent to the horizontal;
the reference plane for applying the regulations of this Section may be located up to five feet above the base plane.
notes: 9,500-PRESENT CHECK: PASS. The figure '9,500' (square feet, minimum zoning-lot area) appears verbatim in this capture, on the official print/PDF render, satisfying the M4-T012 binding capture-completeness requirement.

RECONCILIATION vs docs/ARCHITECT_REVIEW_QUESTIONS.md (owner-verified verbatim, lines 45-52): MATCH. Both sources state identical trigger conditions (lot area >= 9,500 sq ft AND width >= 100 ft, OR slope >= 5 percent measured street-wall-line to rear-wall-line) and the identical allowance (reference plane may be located up to 5 ft above the base plane), for R1/R2 districts without a letter suffix.

Encodes an EXPLICIT CONDITIONAL, never a silent application or a silent omission (D-049-R003): the reference-plane allowance applies ONLY when the trigger condition is affirmatively known to be satisfied; when a needed geometry input (lot area, lot width, or slope) is unavailable, the citing rule fails closed to professional_review_required with no value - it never assumes the allowance does or does not apply.

This paragraph modifies WHERE the reference plane sits for measuring the 25/35 ft envelope (zr-23-421-r1-r2 / zr-23-421-r3-r4); it does NOT itself change the 25 ft / 35 ft numeric caps. The citing rule's output is therefore a SEPARATE typed constraint (reference_plane_elevation_max_ft), never merged into max_perimeter_wall_height or max_building_height.

The full sloping-plane setback geometry (paragraphs (a) through (f)) that this reference plane feeds into remains an A2 gap (D-045-R008); this snapshot's excerpt is deliberately limited to paragraph (g) alone.
Nothing in this record is a Verified zoning determination. Verified requires an M4 published rule plus G6 qualified-human approval (owner directive item 5).
